headline: Mexican Workers' Union League calls strike at Contitech to demand enforcement of the Contrato Ley
summary: The Mexican union LSOM filed a strike notice with the Federal Labor Court against Contitech Mexicana in San Luis Potosí. The union is demanding application of its collective labor contract.
why: Contitech is the industrial rubber and components unit of Continental, supplying automotive and industrial customers. Labor disputes can disrupt plant output and supply chains.
original_headline: Liga Sindical Obrera Mexicana emplaza a huelga a Contitech para exigir aplicación de Contrato Ley
